message.text:
**Evaluating backend paths**

I’m trying to figure out backend paths, knowing that they probably exclude web. I need to list all instances of `^func (...) Close(`, which might include a lot of declarations and mocks. I think there could be dozens of them to sift through. So, the plan is to search through the entire Go codebase, considering maybe around ten to start with and see what I can find. It's a bit of a challenge!

args.command: grep -RInE '^func \([^)]*\) Close\(' . --include='*.go' && grep -RInE '\.Close\(' cmd internal server store --include='*.go' | grep -v '_test.go'
